question: How many people died in the Moscow bombing on August 1, 2026?

steps.content: [2026 Moscow restaurant bombing] On 1 August 2026, a bomb explosion occurred during a private banquet at the Balzi Rossi Italian restaurant on the ground floor of the Kudrinskaya Square Building in central Moscow. The bomber was an unidentified woman who attempted to enter the banquet with an improvised explosive device concealed within a gift box but was intercepted by a security guard. Before she could get inside, the bomb detonated on the restaurant's veranda just outside of the entrance. The explosion killed three people, including the woman, and injured 21 others. Two later died in hospital and six were reported to be in grave conditions. The attack was believed to be an assassination attempt on one or more Russian military officials present at the event, especially Commander-in-Chief of the Russian Aerospace Forces and alleged war criminal, Aleksandr Chayko (born July 27, 1971), who was celebrating his late 55th birthday at the restaurant. | other articles: Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present), August 2004 Moscow Metro bombing

In the Moscow bombing on August 1, 2026, a total of five people died, including the bomber. The initial explosion killed three people, and two others later succumbed to their injuries in the hospital. Additionally, 21 others were injured, with six reported to be in grave condition. 

FINAL: 5 people died.
